findings.description: The 'no inline types' rule is stated with different scopes: §Type separation now bans every inline type/interface, while §Code layout, naming.md and ADR 0116 ban only exported or reused ones.
findings.body:
**The scope of "no inline types" now differs between docs.**

This PR dropped "exported" from §Type separation, which now reads:

> Types live in `*.types.ts` … **Never inline a `type`/`interface` in a `*.service.ts` or `*.routes.ts` file**

Every other statement of the rule is scoped:

- general.md §Code layout (line 35): "An exported or reused `type` / `interface` is never declared in a behavioural file; see §Type separation"
- ADR 0116: "No exported or reused type, interface or `Error` subclass is declared inline in a behavioural file"
- naming.md: "Every exported type or interface is in a `*.types.ts` / `*.interface.ts` file"

§Code layout points the reader to §Type separation, which then bans even a private single-use local alias. An agent that follows one section breaks the other. ADR 0116 wins where the docs conflict, so restore the qualifier here.

https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/1148eda339d09c6957924920ca3b332af3ed4e57/docs/conventions/general.md#L75-L77
findings.suggestion:

findings.description: testing.md, naming.md and general.md state the @src/@test aliases, test/unit/ and test/helpers/ as present-tense rules, but the root tsconfig/vitest config doesn't define the aliases yet, and the testing.md mock example imports through them. Only ADR 0116 §Ceilings says the layout is a target, so add a one-line pointer to it in testing.md.

general.md says validate-file-naming.sh blocks `bar.service.test.ts`, but naming.md's Enforcement section only checks paths under `/src/`. Under the new layout a test in `test/unit/` isn't checked at all.

The old exception for a whole-subject test (`overlap.test.ts` covering a service plus its repository) was removed without saying it is gone. Nothing says where a test goes for a source file with no role suffix (e.g. `index.ts`), and ADR 0104 still cites `overlap.test.ts`.

The `integration.test` row in the role table still says 'needing a real server + DB'. The new §Test files uses `<scenario>.integration.test.ts` for any scenario spanning several subjects, so the two definitions disagree.
The added 'in a `*.errors.ts` file under `errors/`' repeats what §Code layout already says and reads awkwardly. Revert it or write 'in an `errors/*.errors.ts` file'.
The ADR index jumps from 0114 to 0116 and no 0115 file exists. If 115 is reserved by an in-flight PR that's fine; otherwise the numbering has a gap.

process_issues.description: `git show --stat 12a9459` failed in the reviewer's sandbox with a bwrap error on `.git/config.worktree.lock`, so it couldn't inspect that commit on its own. The PR diff covered the same content, so coverage was not lost.
